Birthday girl Lovlina makes history with gold, joins Mary Kom in elite club
articles.description: Lovlina Borgohain made history by clinching a gold medal at the Asian Games, becoming just the second Indian woman boxer to achieve this feat. She delivered an impressive performance, sweeping the finals against China's Ziyi Bao with a perfect 5-0 score. This triumph comes after her silver medal in the last Asian Games, where her journey was highlighted by a semifinal win against world champion Natalya Bogdanova.

articles.title: Ambulance stopped for CM Himanta’s convoy: 4 Assam cops suspended
articles.description: Four traffic cops in Silchar were suspended for briefly halting an ambulance to clear a path for CM Himanta Biswa Sarma. The incident occurred while attempting to transport a critically ill patient to the hospital. Sarma later apologized to the family and stated that emergency medical care should take priority over VIP movement. He also emphasized the importance of implementing guidelines governing convoy procedures.

articles.title: Ford CEO Jim Farley makes clear distinction of the jobs that AI cannot replace
articles.description: Ford's CEO Jim Farley emphasized that artificial intelligence will complement skilled trades workers, assuring that roles requiring hands-on skills and practical judgment are safe despite AI advancements. He pointed out that fostering trust is crucial for the successful collaboration between workers and AI. Additionally, he noted the merging roles of tradespeople and engineers in contemporary manufacturing, showcasing Ford's evolution in job functions to adapt to technology.

Scientists released fluorescent dye nearly 2 km underwater; it revealed deep water rising 100 metres a day
articles.description: Researchers utilized fluorescein dye in the Rockall Trough to study deep ocean water upwelling. They measured rapid upward movement reaching about 125 metres per day, significantly faster than average estimates. This study provides direct observations of upwelling in submarines canyons, offering insights into ocean circulation dynamics. Findings suggest underwater topography plays a crucial role in deep-water circulation processes. Future research aims to explore similar processes in different submarine canyon settings.

articles.title: Jack Johnson’s foundation transformed neglected Hawaii farmland into a thriving farm for students
articles.description: Kōkua Hawaiʻi Foundation acquired unused farmland on Oʻahu in 2019 to create an educational resource. Over six years, more than 40,000 pounds of produce were harvested while 2,200 students participated in learning experiences. The farm emphasizes ecological education, agroforestry, and understanding local food systems through hands-on activities. Community involvement plays a significant role in maintaining the farm through regular volunteer opportunities.

articles.title: Dollar hits 17-month high: Greenback headed for three week gaining streak as bond rout drags euro
articles.description: The US dollar has reached a 17-month high as it benefits from a global bond sell-off. Concerns regarding France’s fiscal stability have adversely affected the euro's value against the dollar. The increase in borrowing costs, particularly with US Treasuries, is influencing market dynamics. Simultaneously, investors are reassessing the Federal Reserve's interest rate plans based on recent job data. Overall, the dollar's strength reflects broader issues occurring in European markets.

articles.title: Gandhi Jayanti: Are NSE, BSE closed for trading on October 2?
articles.description: Stock trading will be halted on October 2, 2026, in observance of Mahatma Gandhi Jayanti. Both the National Stock Exchange and Bombay Stock Exchange will be closed for the day, along with the Multi Commodity Exchange. Investors have faced declines for four consecutive sessions, impacted by foreign selling and escalating crude oil prices. The trading schedule will also be affected by the upcoming Dussehra and Diwali holidays.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.description: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback. With a remarkable twelve-hour battery life on a single charge, this device empowers users with greater independence. The project's goal is to enhance the day-to-day experiences of those with vision impairments.

articles.title: Drishyam 3 Movie Review and Release Live Updates
articles.full_text: With 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion', the Hindi franchise reaches its final chapter. The movie has now opened in theatres with considerable audience interest. The first reactions have focused on the suspense, twists, performances and climax. While most early responses have been favorable, comparisons with the Malayalam version have also become part of the online discussion. As more audiences watch the film, the social media conversation around Ajay Devgn's final outing as Vijay Salgaonkar is expected to expand. Ajay Devgn's 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' arrived in theatres on October 2, bringing the Hindi franchise to its much-awaited conclusion. Early audience reactions on social media have largely been positive. Viewers have praised the film's tension, twists and performances. The climax has also emerged as one of the biggest talking points in the initial reactions. Several moviegoers have taken to X, formerly Twitter, to share their verdict without revealing major spoilers. Directed by Abhishek Pathak, the movie features Ajay Devgn, Tabu, Shriya Saran, Prakash Raj and Jaideep Ahlawat in key roles. Rajat Kapoor is also part of the cast.

articles.title: Kurt Cobain’s Olympia apartment is now an Airbnb
articles.description: Kurt Cobain's former apartment in Olympia is now available for booking on Airbnb, allowing fans to immerse themselves in a pivotal chapter of music history. This space showcases original fixtures and memorabilia, offering an authentic glimpse into Cobain's life during Nirvana's formative years. Guests can explore where some of his iconic tunes were crafted, experiencing the quieter moments before stardom took hold.

articles.description: Salman Khan had an unexpected encounter with an over-excited fan during a screening of 'Prem Keetanu'. The fan managed to approach him despite multiple security personnel being present, which startled the actor. Salman Khan's security team quickly intervened and pulled the fan away, allowing him to proceed inside. The actor was attending the screening to support Veer Pahariya and the film's team.

articles.title: Police did wellness check on Hayden Panettiere week before her passing
articles.description: In a tragic turn of events, Hayden Panettiere was subjected to a wellness check on August 16, prompted by a concerned caller worried about her silence. Following the discovery of her unresponsive state, it was determined that her death resulted from multiple drug toxicities, but no foul play was evident. Investigations into the intricate circumstances are ongoing, while Wladimir Klitschko seeks to manage the inheritance for their daughter, Kaya.
